title: privilege
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): solution_privilege.

accessright.description: Rights a user has to an instance of an entity.

canbebasic.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to the user, the user's team, or objects shared by the user.

canbedeep.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to child business units of the business unit associated with the user.

canbeentityreference.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to the local reference of an external party.

canbeglobal.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to the entire organization.

canbelocal.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to the user's business unit.

canbeparententityreference.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to parent reference of the external party.

canberecordfilter.description: Information that specifies whether the privilege applies to the record filters.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

privilegerowid.description: Unique identifier of the Privilege used when synchronizing customizations for the Microsoft Dynamics CRM client for Outlook

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.
